title: Collision Positivity for Three-Variable Symmetric Monomial Inequalities
summary: Let \(λ\succγ\succμ\) be equal-degree exponent partitions with at most three parts, and let \begin{equation*} P_{λ,γ,μ} = J_λ+J_μ-2J_γ, \end{equation*} where \(J_ν\) denotes the symmetric monomial orbit sum associated with \(ν\). We prove a necessary and sufficient collision criterion for the positivity of this three-point majorization difference in three variables.
